page.layout: One printed page, an engraved plate of episcopal coats of arms. Top row of shields with captions above them; left and right columns of shields with captions beside them; a central composition (mitre, crossed keys, crozier, arms, banner inscriptions); a row of shields with captions below the centre; a bottom row of shields with captions; a single letter "D" below the centre. No running text.

main_text.l: Sedes Londen. Edw. Londes. S. Winton. Rob. Horne. S. Norwic. Joh. Parcutt. S. Eryc. Ric Cant. S. Wigorn N. Ruisingham.
S. Exon. W. Bradbrege. S. Petriburgh. E. Scambler. S. Roffen. E. Freghy, J S. Oxeniens. R Chester. S. Briston.
S. Oxon. Hu. Coren. S. Menevens. R. Davys. S. Asaph. Th. Davies. S. Landaph. A. Davis. S. Bangor. N. Robinson.

page.notes: Plate of arms with captions in small type; the captions are transcribed as printed, in the order they stand on the page (top row, left and right columns, centre, lower rows). Shield designs are engraved and not transcribed. "S Lich & Coven Io Bentley" and "Ciuitas Cant" / "Ciuitas Norwi" are hard to read and uncertain. Left column caption "S. Sarum" and the "Lincoln" caption are partly worn. The top-right "37" is the page number.
